# Contributing to Trident

See the [development guide](../docs/development.md) for the crate layout, builds,
tests and performance tools.

Source comments and docstrings follow the
[canonical source-documentation standard](https://github.com/amagomori/.github/blob/main/docs/rust_documentation.md).
It uses the Rust API Guidelines, Rust Style Guide and rustdoc conventions, with
language-appropriate equivalents outside Rust.

Run the [documentation checks](../docs/development.md#source-documentation) and
review the contracts and safety explanations for any code you change. Do not
reformat generated files, third-party code, license headers or attribution text.
